summary: Computes a session-mode table address as 36 * dword_7D0410 + 8188032 and stores it at this[206] (+0x338), then stores the mode value dword_7D0410 at this[200] (+0x320). If the computed address is non-null, dereferences it, retrieves a UI list item via UIListIndexedAccessor, formats it into a stack buffer through StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, and returns the result of EditBufferStringUpdate on that buffer. If the address is null, returns it immediately. Reads session-mode global dword_7D0410.

operations.description: result = 36 * dword_7D0410 + 8188032; compute the table entry address from the session-mode value (36-byte stride over a table anchored at 8188032).
this[206] = result; store the computed table address at this+0x338.
if (result) — proceed only when the computed table address is non-null; otherwise fall through to the return of result (0).
this[200] = dword_7D0410; store the session-mode value at this+0x320.
v4 = UIListIndexedAccessor(*v3) where v3 is the stored table address this[206]; read the first dword of the table entry and fetch the indexed UI list item from it.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v5, v4); format the UI list item into the 32-byte stack buffer v5 with overflow checking.
return EditBufferStringUpdate(v5); commit the formatted buffer to the edit buffer and return its result.
return result; when the computed address was null, return it (0) without touching the UI list.
